ProtVis maize lysine-acetylation benchmark
==========================================

This benchmark is a real consensus HR-HCD spectrum extracted from the
Maize PeptideAtlas 2023-09 build. The selected peptide contains one
internal lysine acetylation: VGYNPDK[Acetyl]IAFVPISGFEGDNMIER (z=3).
The full PeptideAtlas library is not bundled; only this single spectrum
and its provenance metadata are installed with ProtVisDatabase.

Source: Maize PeptideAtlas, DOI 10.1021/acs.jproteome.4c00320
Best raw spectrum: qe2_03102014_14_o2.28787.28787
Original source PXD: PXD002379
Supporting ProteomeXchange IDs: PXD002379;PXD003634;PXD009627;PXD015819;PXD017077;PXD019635;PXD019804;PXD022863;PXD024698;PXD026269;PXD026369;PXD026378;PXD026760;PXD026853;PXD027417
